INSERT INTO td_stock_catalog (id, symbol, name, currency, exchange, mic_code, country, type, figi_code, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{c.id}, #{c.symbol}, #{c.name}, #{c.currency}, #{c.exchange}, #{c.micCode}, #{c.country}, #{c.type}, #{c.figiCode}, #{c.fetchedAt})
